data.query: How is the summer_sale campaign performing?
data.reference: The summer_sale campaign is performing exceptionally well, with both conversion rate and click-through rate classified as High. The overall performance is also High. Recommendation: Based on the strong performance, continue to invest in and potentially scale the summer_sale campaign.

The brand_awareness campaign is currently performing at a Low level across all key metrics, including Click-Through Rate (CTR) and Conversion Rate. Both CTR and Conversion Rate are classified as Low. Recommendation: This campaign is significantly underperforming. A thorough review of the targeting, ad creative, and budget allocation is strongly recommended.

The retargeting campaign is currently performing at a Medium level across all key metrics, including Click-Through Rate (CTR) and Conversion Rate. Both CTR and Conversion Rate are classified as Medium. Recommendation: To improve performance, consider reviewing the campaign creatives, targeting parameters, and landing page experience. A/B testing different ad copy and call-to-actions could help boost results.
